name: Crisálida
detailed_description:
Crisálida is a narrative-driven game that blends visual novel and point-and-click mechanics to explore grief, memory, and personal healing.

You play as Íris, a woman struggling to move forward after a personal loss during the isolation of a global pandemic. Through interactive scenes, environmental storytelling, and abstract memory puzzles, you will guide Íris as she reconstructs her past and makes choices that define her future.

Each interaction uncovers fragments of truth — some comforting, others painful. But not all memories are what they seem. The story unfolds through multiple paths, leading to five different endings, including one true ending that can only be unlocked through deeper exploration and replay.

Adding a unique musical twist, each choice adds a new instrument to the game’s evolving ambience. The final composition, revealed only after reaching the final point of your choices, becomes a sonic reflection of your journey through Íris’s memories.

With digitally hand-painted scenes, a haunting original soundtrack, and an all-women dev team behind the story, Crisálida invites you to reflect on what we remember, what we forget, and what we carry with us — even in silence...

🌸 Features:

  • A short yet emotionally powerful experience (1–2 hours per playthrough)

  • Five different endings that reward player curiosity and decisions

  • Unique memory-rebuilding puzzles and hidden lore items

  • Optional "easter egg" content that expands the narrative beyond Íris’s perspective

  • A dynamic soundtrack that evolves with every choice you take

  • Digitally hand-painted visuals and immersive soundscapes

  • A love letter to self-discovery and resilience

short_description: A short emotional journey through memory, grief, and healing. Help Íris piece together her fragmented memories and uncover hidden truths about herself and those she loves. Your choices shape the story — only by revisiting the past you will unlock new layers and reveal the true ending (and music).
supported_languages:
English*, Portuguese - Brazil*
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+) / Windows 8 / Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Dual Core CPU @ 2.0 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics or DirectX 10 compatible card
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: Requires a mouse and keyboard.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit recommended)
  • Processor: Quad Core CPU @ 2.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics or DirectX 11 compatible card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: Requires a mouse and keyboard.
